name: play_media
description: Play a NAMED song or video from the local library. Copy every title word exactly as the user wrote it; never drop initial letters or shorten a title. Example: Play Almost Cut My Hair means title Almost Cut My Hair, not Most Cut My Hair. Use this alone for named playback. Optional artist, album, or format only when stated.

title.description: The complete requested media title. Preserve its beginning. When the request ends with an artist possessive plus version, put that name in artist instead: 'Play Born on the Bayou John Fogerty's version' means title 'Born on the Bayou' and artist 'John Fogerty'. Never return only 'Bayou'.

artist.description: An artist explicitly named by the user, including the name before the possessive phrase 'artist's version'.

name: control_playback
description: Control the current track: play, resume, pause, stop, previous track, or next track. Do not use for skipping, forwarding, or rewinding by seconds.

name: skip_forward_10_seconds
description: Only skip forward, go forward, or move ahead exactly 10 seconds. Never use this tool for rewind, back, or backward.

name: rewind_back_10_seconds
description: Only rewind, go back, or move backward exactly 10 seconds. Never use this tool for skip, forward, or ahead.

name: show_mp3_files
description: Use for exactly this kind of request: Show MP3 files. Filter the media list to MP3 audio files. This does not open the library panel.

name: show_original_videos
description: Use for exactly this kind of request: Show original videos. Filter the media list to original MP4 videos. This does not open the library panel.

name: show_karaoke_files_or_videos
description: Use for exactly this kind of request: Show karaoke files. Filter the media list to karaoke files or videos. This does not open the library panel.

name: show_all_media
description: Use for exactly this kind of request: Show all media. Clear the media category filter. This does not open the library panel.

name: search_library
description: Search the media library for a user-provided title or artist query. Do not use this to show a media category or to show or hide the library panel.

name: refresh_library
description: Refresh or rescan the local media library.

name: set_volume
description: Set playback volume from 0 to 100 percent. Use only for an explicit volume request. Never add an EQ preset.

name: load_eq_preset
description: Load a named equalizer preset. Use only when the user explicitly requests an EQ preset. Never add a volume.

name: show_graphic_equalizer_panel
description: Show, open, or display the Graphic Equalizer panel. Use only when the user names the equalizer.

name: close_graphic_equalizer_panel
description: Use for exactly this kind of request: Close the Graphic Equalizer. Close or hide the equalizer panel.

name: open_media_library_panel
description: Open, show, or display the Media Library panel only when the user explicitly says library. Do not use for requests to show MP3, original, karaoke, or all media files.

name: hide_media_library_panel
description: Use for exactly this kind of request: Hide the library. Hide or close the Media Library panel only when the user explicitly says library.

name: close_performance_monitor_panel
description: Use for exactly this kind of request: Close the performance monitor. Close or hide the Performance Monitor panel.

name: set_panel
description: Show, hide, open, close, or toggle only the voice command or sidebar panel.
